pages.text: $(bold)Keep inventory is on.$() Death costs equipment durability based on dimension: Overworld ~10%, T2 ~15%, T3 ~20%, T4 ~25%.$(br2)$(bold)Inert Items:$() At 0 durability, items become inert (no stats/function) but stay in inventory. Repair at anvil or via Mending. Nothing is ever permanently lost.$(br2)$(bold)Soulbound:$() Treasure enchant (structure/boss drops only). Soulbound III = immune to death penalty. I-II reduce loss by 50%/75%.$(br2)$(bold)Wanderer Bonus:$() Survivor passive reduces death durability loss by 25%.
